# Log Entry \#9

# Week of April 8-15

# **MOre models**

I finished the model for the gramophone and vinyls. I just need to get their scripts running.  
I also created a disk receiver port that will be on all output devices. This is where you put the floppy disk. There will be en eject button but I didn’t model it in blender because of how simple it is.

Now, I only need a couple display models, the hologram (which will be 1 model), the writer station control panels, and the lab environment.  
The most time consuming of these will be the lab environment, so I plan on making it extremely simple.  
The hologram will also have multiple textures but it will just be the default texture and xray. I will use shadergraph to make the xray texture and the default texture is the same as how I usually create models.

# **Datamosh iteration**

I’ve been trying to fix the zoom that happens when datamoshing. The issue is with my grab pass shader. I’ve been using Claude to figure out why it isn’t working, and it seems to be that my methods are outdated, and I have to use Unity’s new system for global post-processing called RenderGraphFeature.

For the next 2 weeks, I need to create the video file reader, hologram file reader, and videogame file reader scripts (on top of the models of course).   
It is going to be difficult, but I believe I can make it.
